batch.description: Jahangirnagar University D Unit (Biological Sciences / জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ), academic session 2017-2018, Set-3 — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the AdmissionWar/Google Drive scan distributed as 'ju-d-2017-2018-set2.pdf' (6 pp.). LABEL MISMATCH: the Drive listing calls this file Set-2, but the paper's own printed header (p.1) reads 'SET CODE: 3'; per project rules the PRINTED code governs, so the paper is recorded as Set-3 and the source filename is preserved in the sourceDocument for traceability. The scan is a solved-paper reprint in which every question carries a printed boxed 'Ans-X' key and most carry a printed ব্যাখ্যা (explanation). EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED; the printed compilation keys are preserved as-is (including Q50's key box, which contradicts the compilation's own printed explanation — see ANSWERS.md/EXTRACTION_NOTES.md) and are NOT official JU keys. One printed dual key (Q71, 'Ans-A, B') is encoded as multiple_choice. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: JU D Unit admission test 2017-2018, printed Set Code 3 — solved-paper scan (AdmissionWar / Google Drive; listed as Set-2)
sourceDocuments.notes: Scanned solved-paper reprint distributed via admissionwar.com (Google Drive file id 1fIKGkH8WKlqupb6J-QOm8mss3sXVatuo), 6 pages, CamScanner scan. The Drive listing labels it Set-2, but the printed header (p.1) reads: '১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৭-২০১৮', 'D ইউনিট, জীববিজ্ঞান, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়', 'SET CODE: 3' (boxed, top right of the header), 'সময়ঃ ৬০ মিনিট, পূর্ণমানঃ ৮০', '(প্রতিটি ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২০ নম্বর কাটা যাবে। প্রশ্নপত্রে উত্তর চিহ্নিত করা যাবে না)' and two OMR practice sentences (ক) আমার ভাইয়ের রক্তে রাঙানো একুশে ফেব্রুয়ারি; খ) Smoking is injurious to health). The printed code 3 is used for the paper id. Key form: a printed boxed 'Ans-A/B/C/D' beside each question (Q71's box prints 'Ans-A, B', a dual key), plus printed ব্যাখ্যা boxes for most questions; pen ticks, circles and underlines on the scan are a reader's hand marks, NOT keys, and were ignored. Page footers 'For More Question Bank Visit…', 'Visit www.admissionwar.com' and 'Scanned by CamScanner' are aggregator marks, not paper content. Transcription by direct visual reading of 300-dpi page renders (quarter-page crops; zoomed re-reads for Q22, Q25, Q35(a), Q55, Q59). Composition: Bangla 4 (Q1-4), English 4 (Q5-8), IQ 1 (Q9), General Mathematics 3 (Q10-12), Biology 44 (Q13-34 Zoology, Q35-56 Botany; printed as one continuous run with no section headings — the split is by content), Chemistry 24 (Q57-80). Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √; chemical subscripts as plain digits, e.g. H2SO4; nuclides as ^mass, e.g. ^235U).
